intent: Reproduce an authoritative Design Contract without inventing a competing visual direction.
steps: Load the Design Contract and verify every authoritative reference is accessible
Map mandatory structure, text, components, states and viewports from the contract
Search the design system inventory before creating any new component
Implement only within permitted free_zones; escalate gaps as clarification or decision requests
Do not silently improve palette, layout hierarchy or copy against the mockup
Produce implementation artifacts and attach visual evidence bindings (route, state, viewport, reference, commit)
invariants: Authoritative mockups win over agent aesthetic defaults
frontend-design creative procedure must not be the primary procedure in conform mode
Inferences remain non-authoritative until human validation
